thread:
alex: Customer ACME (ticket #12345) reports mass 5xx + streaming timeouts since 04:12 UTC. They hit our hosted inference endpoint /v1/generate. They saw p95 latency spike to 8s and intermittent 502/504. Attaching client repro snippet:
```
POST /v1/generate 504 after 30s
body: {"input":"..."}
```
They can repro consistently with a batch of 16 payloads. Raising warroom? @oncall-bot please page.

maria: Looking at ingress logs now. Fanout to EU pools spiked ~04:11 UTC and queue depth jumped. Error rate correlates with kvcache miss surge on runtime nodes. Sending traces to INC-12345 and linking here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-12345

jamal: Repro steps I used locally: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?model=redwood-ggml run 16x via xargs. Observed connection resets from edge at ~30s and backend 502s from runtime pods.

rachel: I'm going to roll a temporary routing override to prefer the dedicated pool in eu-west-1 for this customer and watch. If errors drop we keep that until we fix autoscaler.

deploy-bot: deploy start r-routing-2026-03-18 by rachel

alex: rachel, post the runbook link and add a short customer-facing mitigation note we can send.

rachel: runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/timeout-cascade-playbook (adding a short blurb now)

maria: Quick mitigation I recommend: reduce hosted batch_count from 16 -> 8 and enable prefix cache warmup for the affected model family. Applying canary now.

jamal: Patch applied in canary eu-west-1. Observed error rate drop ~70% and p95 latency down from 8s -> 2.1s for the repro traffic.

alex: Solid. Let's capture action items before we lose context: 1) Short-term: rollout batch_count=8 across EU/US hosted clusters (owner: rachel). 2) Medium-term: root cause kvcache warmup race and add deterministic warmup at replica spin-up + telemetry (owner: maria). 3) Long-term: adjust autoscaler to do gradual pre-warm when sudden fanout detected (owner: jamal). 4) Customer comms: draft update + mitigation steps and confirm ETA for full fix (owner: alex).

rachel: Opening PR for the rollout config change and scheduling deploy in the 02:00 UTC window to avoid peak.

maria: I'll add a dashboard tile for kvcache miss ratio and an alert when miss_rate > 5% + p95 latency > 3s. Also will instrument per-model warmup timing.

alex: Thanks all. I'll draft the customer message and post the short-term mitigation instructions to the ticket. We'll do a full postmortem and link action items there. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident severity reduced; warroom closed. Follow-up to be tracked in INC-12345 postmortem.
